private-link-data-transfer-extra.title: Private Link data processing is charged on top of normal data transfer
private-link-data-transfer-extra.body: This estimate sends data through private endpoints. The Private Link per-GB charge is a premium for the Private Link capability; Microsoft states that normal data transfer pricing still applies to the same data, so check bandwidth costs separately.

citation.quote: Yes, above prices are premiums for Private Link capability. Data transfer pricing will apply to data.

private-link-peered-traffic.title: Traffic to a private endpoint over peering is not charged as peering
private-link-peered-traffic.body: Reaching a private endpoint across a peered network is billed only as Private Link data processing; Microsoft says peering is not charged for that traffic. Do not also count that traffic in the peering volume.

citation.quote: While accessing Private Endpoints from peered Network, you will only be charged for Private Link Premium. You will not be charged for Peering.
